page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin beside the text. Running head at the top with the page number 126 and the catchword-style signature "Cap. 7" at the top left. A centred heading-like line "10." with an italic summary line below it. A word "CAP." at the bottom right, as a catchword.

main_text.p: nos, ut abnegantes impietatem, & saeculária desideria, sobrie & juste & pie vivamus in hoc saeculo, exspectantes beatam spem & adventum gloriæ magni Dei & Salvatoris nostri Iesu Christi, qui dedit semetipsum pro nobis, ut nos redimeret ab omni iniquitate, & mundaret sibi populum acceptabilem, sectatorem bonorum operum.
10. Hanc vitæ sanctimoniam ad salutem Christi obtinendam esse necessariam.
Vide & Ioan.3.2.Matth.5. 20. Dico vobis, quia nisi abundaverit iustitia vestra plusquam Scribarum, & Pharisæorum, non intrabitis in regnum cælorum.
Roman.8. 13. Si secundum carnem vixeritis, moriemini; si autem Spiritu facta carnis mortificaveritis, vivetis.

Ephes.5. Hebr.12. 14. Gal. 6.7.8.1.Cor.6. 9.10. An nescitis, quia iniqui regnum Dei non possidebunt? Nolite errare; Neque fornicarii, neque idolis servientes, neque adulteri, neque molles, neque masculorum concubitores, neque fures, neque avari, neque ebriosi, neque maledici, neque rapaces, regnum Dei possidebunt.

page.notes: Marginal references in the left margin: "Vide & Ioan.3.2." beside Matth.5.20; "Ephes.5. Hebr.12. 14. Gal. 6.7.8." beside 1.Cor.6. Greek-less page. The first line of the running head is printed as "Cap.7." with "126" as page number. Some letters in the text are uncertain due to faint print.
